source.surface: duplicate-filename conflict on upload, three resolutions offered, one pre-selected and not yet confirmed
source.attribution: Screen curated by Mobbin (https://mobbin.com). Inspected remotely through the Mobbin MCP under accessMode 'remote-mcp'. No image was downloaded, cached, embedded, or stored anywhere in this repository; every value below is our own reading of the rendered screen.

evidenceTier.rationale: Mobbin is a curated gallery of captured screens. It is not a live observation we made of a running product, and no audience outcome is attached, so it cannot be silver/M2 or gold/M3. Treat these facts as evidence that a shipped product once looked this way, not as evidence that it worked.

decisionColour.acceptControlTreatment: solid blue fill with a white label
decisionColour.rejectControlTreatment: none as a button; the only refusal is the close glyph at the top right, or choosing the third option, "Cancel upload for this item"
decisionColour.undecidedContainerTreatment: the pre-selected option's ENTIRE ROW carries a blue border and a filled blue radio, while the two unselected rows carry grey borders — the decision hue is painted on a container before the user has confirmed anything
decisionColour.verdict: Recorded as a COUNTER-INSTANCE and the closest external match to the defect we fixed in our own product this week. The same blue that fills Confirm also outlines the option container that has not been confirmed. A reader glancing at this modal sees a resolution already dressed as chosen; only the Confirm button distinguishes selected from settled.
